items.heading: Ilish Bhapa
details: Key ingredients: hilsa fish, mustard paste, mustard oil, green chili
Coat hilsa fish steaks with a smooth mustard seed paste.
Add mustard oil, turmeric and slit green chilies.
Place in a covered dish and steam gently until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

items.heading: Beef Bhuna
details: Key ingredients: beef, onion, ginger-garlic paste, whole spices
Marinate beef chunks with ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Slow-cook the beef with onions, stirring occasionally, until the liquid reduces.
Continue cooking until the oil separates and the beef is deeply browned.
Finish with a sprinkle of garam masala and serve with rice.

items.heading: Kacchi Biryani
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
